item.summary: fix(gateway): evict expired non-abortable runs instead of retrying forever (#123532) The maintenance sweeper aborted expired active entries and ignored the result. A non-abortable entry (signal already aborted via direct controller.abort, or a frozen reply operation) whose owner cleanup was lost survived every sweep: phantom active run in sessions.list, Stop answering no-active-run while the row showed running, pinned dedupe key, skipped media GC. The sweeper now removes the entry when the timeout abort reports aborted:false — mirroring the adjacent inactive-entry branch. Sibling of the terminal-pending bound fixed in #123192.
